builder_plan.scenario: Start with one repeated product task that has a measurable failure or cost.
builder_plan.change: Read the methods and identify one change you can isolate in that workflow.
builder_plan.baseline: Your current implementation on the same held-out tasks.
steps: Locate the paper's implementation and check its license, model support, data needs, and hardware requirements. Stop here if you cannot obtain the required artifacts.
Save a small set of representative product tasks and expected outcomes. Keep evaluation tasks out of any training or tuning, and choose quality and cost limits before running.
Run the baseline and the proposed change on identical inputs. Keep other settings fixed and repeat paired runs to expose variation.
Save per-task outputs, failures, timings, and all usage costs. Review regressions before expanding the test.
builder_plan.measure: Successful outcomes, response time, human rework, and total cost per successful task.
builder_plan.decision: Keep the change only if it meets your preselected quality and latency limits and improves the metric you care about after setup and operating costs. Otherwise retain the baseline. This is an exploration plan, not a validated recommendation.

title: EgoHand: Monocular 3D Hand Reconstruction from Egocentric Video
summary: EgoHand replaces prior monocular egocentric hand-reconstruction pipelines (e.g., Apple EgoDex, Ropedia Xperience-10M) with a single transformer model over 2D hand crops using the SOMA-Hand parametric representation, released under a license permitting commercial use. Adoption costs the engineering effort of integrating a specialized vision model whose training required a 14-million-image curated corpus, though inference itself is cheap at roughly 9.69 ms per frame on standard hardware. It can fail on egocentric domains outside its training distribution, under occlusion or unusual camera intrinsics, and provides no value if the reader's production workload does not involve egocentric hand tracking.
rationale: This is a specialized computer-vision model for egocentric 3D hand reconstruction, which falls outside the LLM/agent efficiency areas and is irrelevant to the reader's production practice unless they build AR/VR or egocentric video applications.

claims.statement: EgoHand replaces prior monocular egocentric hand-reconstruction pipelines (e.g., Apple EgoDex, Ropedia Xperience-10M) with a single transformer model over 2D hand crops using the SOMA-Hand parametric representation, released under a license permitting commercial use. Adoption costs the engineering effort of integrating a specialized vision model whose training required a 14-million-image curated corpus, though inference itself is cheap at roughly 9.69 ms per frame on standard hardware. It can fail on egocentric domains outside its training distribution, under occlusion or unusual camera intrinsics, and provides no value if the reader's production workload does not involve egocentric hand tracking.

Reports ~9.69 ms inference latency and lower joint-position, root-translation, and acceleration errors than baselines in zero-shot evaluation on HOT3D, ARCTIC, and H2O; no multiplicative factor is stated.
